successorMapping.rehearsedAs: 24 measured requests (12 translation + 12 rewriting) at 1/15 scale of the 360-request workload.
4 concurrent operations with N-in-flight discipline and disclosed final drain (10-way host behavior stays with the successor).
2 translation directions x 3 bands x 2 per cell; 2 rewriting language/mode cells x 3 bands x 2 per cell.
4 requests per band per family (translation) and 4 per band (rewriting); bands keep the 1-100/101-500/501-1000 canonical bounds.
12 distinct source/settings combinations (6 per family), each repeated once with a fresh submission identity. The 60-per-band rotation rule is successor-only.
Recorded interleave seed 37037; every repeat carries a fresh UUIDv7; the composition auditor fails repeats-by-replay.
First-seen/repeated cohorts distinguished structurally; provider-cache cohorts stay unknown (insufficient evidence, never assumed); application/runner reuse disabled and asserted.
Host-readiness probes are predeclared and reported separately, never counted. Quota/budget exhaustion handling is successor-only: the rehearsal is unpaid with a fresh account far below allowance.
Submission-to-complete-body timing over real HTTP against the owned loopback host. No TestServer, runner, or mocked timing.
Full-denominator success-within-target, nearest-rank p50/p95, and per-route/cell distributions, separately per family; no successful-only percentile.
Versioned report carries every section 6.1 field with rehearsal values; deployment identity describes the loopback rehearsal host (hardware/region recorded as the local machine, network as loopback).
All rehearsal inputs stay within the percentile bound (longest 800 canonical chars). L-1/L/L+1 cases are successor-only section 6.2 scope.
